card.name: Decimal point or comma inside numbers
card.fires_on: The period or comma in the middle of a number, right after the first digits, as in 9.9 or 2,400,000. It is strongest in dose amounts and tables of figures.

modes.label: Decimal point in doses
modes.description: A decimal point after a leading digit in a dose or volume.

modes.label: Thousands comma
modes.description: A comma separating thousands in a large count or amount.
modes.example: approximately 77,000 adult patients and 4<<,>>500 pediatric patients
